video.title: A Calendar for Two Households
video.script: If you're splitting custody, you need a shared calendar. You probably want to chat about logistics. And yes, someone needs to track who paid for braces. Most coparenting apps treat you like you're headed to court. Two Households just gives you the basics. A calendar that works, a message thread that sticks around, and a ledger. No legal theater, no per-parent subscription. Try it out.
